title: combattext
summary: The scrolling combat text covers player and owned pet/guardian/totem damage, including Benilla's white player melee, gold player/pet spell and orange pet melee branches, plus category-specific lifetime/rise/fade/scale presentation, heals, periodic ticks, power, environmental damage, miss words, aura changes, combat-state lines, latched 20-percent resource warnings, and positive SMSG_PVP_CREDIT honor gains. Live honor-award verification remains outstanding.

openItems.text: Owned pet/guardian/totem melee and spell sources are suppressed because world combat text only accepts the controlled player's GUID; Benilla accepts SummonedBy/CreatedBy ownership and colors pet melee orange.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: World combat text classifies UNIT_FIELD_SUMMONEDBY/CREATEDBY ownership, admits owned melee/spell/periodic/shield/miss sources, renders pet melee 0xffff8400 orange, and retains shared 0xffffde00 gold for pet spell damage.

openItems.text: No aura gain/fade lines (COMBAT_TEXT_SHOW_AURAS default on in Benilla)
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: player aura descriptor changes now resolve spell names and enqueue helpful-green or harmful-red gain lines; the '<name> fades' path is implemented behind Benilla's default-off aura-fade gate, with initial snapshot suppression.

openItems.text: No entering/leaving-combat state lines (COMBAT_TEXT_SHOW_COMBAT_STATE default on)
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: player UNIT_FLAG_IN_COMBAT transitions now enqueue exact red 'Entering Combat' and 'Leaving Combat' lines without emitting on the initial baseline.

openItems.text: No low-health / low-mana threshold warnings (20% law)
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: health and mana warnings use an exact <=20% crossing latch, only mana power type participates, recovery unlatches, and focused clinical coverage pins repeat behavior.

2026-08-22: strict 16-byte SMSG_PVP_CREDIT decoding now admits positive honor awards and enqueues exact self-anchored 'Honor: <amount>' world text using Benilla category 5's 4500 ms lifetime, no-rise path, gold color, and fade law.

openItems.text: Earn one live positive honor award on VMaNGOS and confirm the strict 16-byte SMSG_PVP_CREDIT payload produces the self-anchored category-5 line once.
